location: 矮人矿山 · 熔炉盆地
note: 身份: 熔炉盆地工人,提供熔炉电话服务。关系: 收到一组污秽之肉后提供私人联系方式。口吻: 随和、自嘲,信号差时会急起来。性格: 务实,会吐槽工作和电话推销。禁用: 不改动一组燃料的条件,不乱加网络梗或粗口。

messages.raw: §fThese forges have been running at an endermite's pace!
messages.text: These forges have been running at an endermite's pace!
messages.gloss: endermite 用《我的世界》官方中文译名“末影螨”。
messages.zh: 这些熔炉慢得像只末影螨!

messages.raw: §fMy job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.
messages.text: My job here is to make sure the lava flows and that the titanium shines.
messages.gloss: Titanium 已确定译“钛”,见 GLOSSARY.md。
messages.zh: 我在这儿的活儿,就是保证岩浆一直流、钛一直亮。

messages.raw: §fYep, it's mostly watching other people work!
messages.text: Yep, it's mostly watching other people work!
messages.zh: 是啊,基本上就是看别人干活!

messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 3 September 2026, at 01:25.

messages.text: The signal doesn't work too well around here, but suit yourself.
messages.raw: §fThe signal doesn't work too well around here, but suit yourself.
messages.zh: 这儿的信号可不太好,不过你愿意就行。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 3 September 2026, at 01:25.

messages.text: Could definitely use some help, if you are willing to trade.
messages.raw: §fCould definitely use some help, if you are willing to trade.
messages.zh: 你要是愿意做个交换,我倒确实有件事想请你帮忙。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 3 September 2026, at 01:25.

messages.text: The Forge doesn't charge users for its fuel, but we're using a mountain of it every day.
messages.raw: §fThe Forge doesn't charge users for its fuel, but we're using a mountain of it every day.
messages.zh: 熔炉不向使用者收燃料费,可我们每天烧掉的燃料都堆成山了。
messages.last_edited: This page was last edited on 3 September 2026, at 01:25.

messages.text: I'm a little ashamed to admit it, but we mostly use Foul Flesh nowadays.
messages.raw: §fI'm a little ashamed to admit it, but we mostly use §9Foul Flesh §fnowadays.
messages.zh: 说出来有点不好意思,我们现在主要烧的是污秽之肉。

messages.zh: 给我一组污秽之肉,我就把私人联系方式给你。
